question: What socialized housing compliance percentage is legally required for residential subdivision projects under PD 957?
answer: The socialized housing compliance percentage required for residential subdivision projects under PD 957 is 10%. This requirement is stated in [S1] and [S2] of the City Planning CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-3.pdf and 2.pdf on printed pages 716, 707, respectively.
